Write code that calls a hosted LLM to extract structured JSON from text using a concrete provider.

You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Mistral:
  Service: Mistral Chat API
  SDK: mistralai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: chat.complete
  Setup hints: MISTRAL_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.mistral.ai/api/

Option 2 — Anthropic:
  Service: Anthropic Messages API
  SDK: anthropic
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: messages.create
  Setup hints: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/api/messages

Option 3 — Gemini API:

  SDK: google-genai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: models.generate_content
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/text-generation

Option 4 — Amazon Nova/Titan via Bedrock:
  Service: Amazon Bedrock Runtime
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: invoke_model, converse
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/boto3/latest/reference/services/bedrock-runtime/client/invoke_model.html

Option 5 — GPT via OpenAI/Azure OpenAI:
  Service: OpenAI / Azure OpenAI chat completions
  SDK: openai
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: chat.completions.create
  Setup hints: OPENAI_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/chat/create

Option 6 — Qwen via DashScope:

  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: Generation.call
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/qwen-api

output_text:
```python
import os
import json
from anthropic import Anthropic, MessagesApi

# Set the provider API key from the environment
anthropic_key = os.getenv("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY")
anthropic_client = Anthropic(api_key=anthropic_key)

# Function to extract structured JSON from text
def extract_structured_json(prompt: str, model: str = "claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620") -> dict:
    """
    Extract structured JSON from a given text prompt using the Anthropic API.

    Args:
        prompt (str): The input text to process.
        model (str, optional): The model to use for the request. Defaults to "claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620".

    Returns:
        dict: The extracted structured JSON.
    """
    # Define the messages, including system message and user message
    messages = [
        {"role": "system", "content": "The model should respond with valid JSON only."},
        {"role": "user", "content": prompt},
    ]

    # Send the request to the Anthropic API
    response = anthropic_client.messages.create(
        model=model,  # Specify the model to use
        max_tokens=4096,  # Set the maximum number of tokens for the response
        temperature=0,  # Use deterministic output
        messages=messages,  # Provide the conversation messages
    )

    # Parse the response to extract JSON
    assistant_message = response.message.content[0].text
    try:
        json_response = json.loads(assistant_message)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        raise ValueError(f"The model response '{assistant_message}' is not valid JSON.")

    return json_response

# Example usage
if __name__ == "__main__":
    sample_prompt = "Extract the title, director, and release year from the following movie data: 'The title is Inception, directed by Christopher Nolan, released in 2010.'"
    try:
        json_result = extract_structured_json(sample_prompt)
        print(json_result)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}")
```
